theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_wedge_annihilator_subspace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P (d + 1)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, ∫ y, ζ₀ (exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y) ∂ν = 0) → ∃ V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) ∧ ∀ w ∈ Vᗮ, ∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ₀ γ = 0
